_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
The test shrinks the app's tail-first mounting so that a 15-turn conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} spans many chunks: on load only the last few chunks mount (as ".messages-chunk" elements) and older history renders as placeholders ([data-testid="pending-chunk"]). "The counts" are pending = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="pending-chunk"]').length and mounted = document.querySelectorAll('.messages-chunk').length. "The gap" is the messages container's (".messages-container") scrollHeight - scrollTop - clientHeight. To "open the conversation", navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}, wait for the message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) to be visible (allow 30s), then wait until the LAST element matching [data-testid="message"] is visible (its getBoundingClientRect() has a non-zero width and height; allow 30s). The test has already set the shelley.tailFirstTest knob; do not set it yourself. Check every assertion with an eval that has "expect" (or an assert_* or wait_* step): an eval without "expect" asserts nothing. Wait with such steps and a timeout, not with polling loops inside the expression. When a step says to record something, do it in one eval without "expect" that stores it in the named window variable, then check that variable in a separate eval with "expect". Perform the steps in order. A streaming append while history is unmounted keeps the tail pinned; the background sweep is off.
1. Open the conversation.
2. pending must be greater than 0.
3. Fill the message input with "echo tail-first append" and click the send button ([data-testid="send-button"]).
4. Wait until a [data-testid="message"] element containing the text "echo tail-first append" is visible (allow 30s), then until the agent-thinking indicator ([data-testid="agent-thinking"]) is hidden (allow 30s; it may already be hidden, so do not wait for it to appear first).
5. Wait until the gap is below 5 (allow 15s): the append rendered at the bottom and stayed pinned.
6. pending must still be greater than 0: the placeholders were left alone.

steps.expression: (() => { const els = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="message"]'); if (!els.length) return 'none'; const last = els[els.length - 1]; const r = last.getBoundingClientRect(); return (r.width > 0 && r.height > 0) ? 'visible' : 'hidden'; })()

(() => { const c = document.querySelector('.messages-container'); if (!c) return 'no-container'; const gap = c.scrollHeight - c.scrollTop - c.clientHeight; return gap < 5 ? 'pinned' : String(gap); })()
